caption: The drawing depicts a single light-colored statue of a woman set against a plain, muted blue background. The statue features a woman standing with her left leg forward, as if in mid-stride, and her head tilted upwards. She has long, wavy hair flowing down her back and wears a short-sleeved dress that drapes to her knees, adorned with detailed patterns and folds. Around her waist is a belt or sash, and she has jewelry such as bracelets and a necklace. Her facial expression appears serene and calm, and her arms rest naturally by her sides. The entire statue is rendered in shades of off-white, while the background is uniformly blue, creating a strong contrast that emphasizes the figure. The base of the statue is irregular, grounding the figure and showing it as a complete sculptural piece.
title: Figurehead: "Cassandra Adams"
